||VM|| Experiment Server

IP: 78.129.250.5:27019

That's right guys, we have a new server. Many thanks to kuromeku for making this possible, and extra credit to Lexi for setting it all up for us.

This is a server with few rules. It is a dog eat dog world, player run, player policed. You don't like someone? Go kick their ass IC, take everything they have, crush them. Believe me, it is far more rewarding than crying to an admin.

Admin status does not carry over to this new server, it must be earned. This server has had the ban list cleared, so everyone gets another chance. Come on down.

Only a few rules must be set and enforced by the admin team; the main hook of experiment was that it was entirely run by the players - a little too much sometimes. The main rules would be:
1) Do not prop kill.
2) Do not prop surf.
3) Only use one layer of prop block per door.
4) Do not kill in public (Do not kill in safe zones?).
5) Do not stat whore.
6) Do not disconnect to avoid roleplay.

See you there.

-KiZai
